entries.title: Mark 3:1
segments: ¶And He entered the synagogue again, and a man was there who had a withered hand.

entries.title: Mark 3:2
segments: So they watched Him closely, whether He would heal him on the Sabbath, so that they might accuse Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:3
segments: And He said to the man who had the withered hand, "Step forward."

entries.title: Mark 3:4
segments: Then He said to them, "Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?" But they kept silent.

entries.title: Mark 3:5
segments: And when He had looked around at them with anger, being grieved by the hardness of their hearts, He said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." And he stretched [it] out, and his hand was restored as whole as the other.

entries.title: Mark 3:6
segments: Then the Pharisees went out and immediately plotted with the Herodians against Him, how they might destroy Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:7
segments: But Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea. And a great multitude from Galilee followed Him, and from Judea

entries.title: Mark 3:8
segments: and Jerusalem and Idumea and beyond the Jordan; and those from Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they heard how many things He was doing, came to Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:9
segments: So He told His disciples that a small boat should be kept ready for Him because of the multitude, lest they should crush Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:10
segments: For He healed many, so that as many as had afflictions pressed about Him to touch Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:11
segments: And the unclean spirits, whenever they saw Him, fell down before Him and cried out, saying, "You are the Son of God."

entries.title: Mark 3:12
segments: But He sternly warned them that they should not make Him known.

entries.title: Mark 3:13
segments: ¶And He went up on the mountain and called to [Him] those He Himself wanted. And they came to Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:14
segments: Then He appointed twelve, that they might be with Him and that He might send them out to preach,

entries.title: Mark 3:15
segments: and to have power to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

entries.title: Mark 3:16
segments: Simon, to whom He gave the name Peter;

entries.title: Mark 3:17
segments: James the [son] of Zebedee and John the brother of James, to whom He gave the name Boanerges, that is, "Sons of Thunder";

entries.title: Mark 3:18
segments: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James the [son] of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Cananite;

entries.title: Mark 3:19
segments: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him. And they went into a house.

entries.title: Mark 3:20
segments: Then the multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

entries.title: Mark 3:21
segments: But when His own people heard [about this], they went out to lay hold of Him, for they said, "He is out of His mind."

entries.title: Mark 3:22
segments: ¶And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, "He has Beelzebub," and, "By the ruler of the demons He casts out demons."

entries.title: Mark 3:23
segments: So He called them to [Himself] and said to them in parables: "How can Satan cast out Satan?

entries.title: Mark 3:24
segments: "If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

entries.title: Mark 3:25
segments: "And if a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

entries.title: Mark 3:26
segments: "And if Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he cannot stand, but has an end.

entries.title: Mark 3:27
segments: "No one can enter a strong man's house and plunder his goods, unless he first binds the strong man. And then he will plunder his house.

entries.title: Mark 3:28
segments: "Assuredly, I say to you, all sins will be forgiven the sons of men, and whatever blasphemies they may utter;

entries.title: Mark 3:29
segments: "but he who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation" --

entries.title: Mark 3:30
segments: because they said, "He has an unclean spirit."

entries.title: Mark 3:31
segments: ¶Then His brothers and His mother came, and standing outside they sent to Him, calling Him.

entries.title: Mark 3:32
segments: And a multitude was sitting around Him; and they said to Him, "Look, Your mother and Your brothers are outside seeking You."

entries.title: Mark 3:33
segments: But He answered them, saying, "Who is My mother, or My brothers?"

entries.title: Mark 3:34
segments: And He looked around in a circle at those who sat about Him, and said, "Here are My mother and My brothers!

entries.title: Mark 3:35
segments: "For whoever does the will of God is My brother and My sister and mother."
